d: Spain's Canary Islands have recorded a record surge in migrant arrivals, with more than 2,100 people reaching the archipelago in overcrowded boats within 24 hours. Maritime rescue services reported one death during the crossing, while another migrant gave birth at sea. Most of the arrivals were recorded on El Hierro, a key entry point for migrants travelling from West Africa. The surge comes days ahead of Spain's November 29 parliamentary election, with migration emerging as a key campaign issue.
